en.title: How Proper Scoring Rules Shape LLM Forecasting
en.hook: Discover how the choice of reward function fundamentally shapes the performance and behavior of LLM forecasters.
key_takeaways: Compares five proper scoring rules as training objectives for binary forecasts
Analyzes how training objectives impact the calibration of LLM predictors
Provides insights for designing more reliable forecasting AI architectures

zh.title: 恰当的评分规则如何塑造大模型的预测能力

key_takeaways: 对比了五种用于二元预测任务的恰当评分规则
揭示了训练目标设定对大模型预测校准的具体影响
为构建更加可靠的预测型 AI 系统提供了理论参考
